issues: 没有导出时长，工作台按 md 的 22f 渲染，砸落后的 hold 被截掉
调试标题 SCORE SLAM 压在虚化 dashboard 上还被切掉一半；背景虚化后依然抢眼，没有把视线收到卡上
KPI 卡是 3px 灰边 + Helvetica 粗字 + 宽字距标签，像线框稿；高空 2.5 倍大时和落地后一样锐利，读不出"从镜头前砸下"
冲击环是 6px 实黑圈、尘点是黑色小方块，读作贴纸而不是冲击
changes: 补导出 SCORE_SLAM_DURATION = 135（源码时间轴：30f 动作与余波 + 105f 静止 hold）
去掉调试标题；dashboard 虚化加到 9px，砸落途中压上一层径向 scrim，把视线收到 KPI 卡
卡片换成出版级 KPI 面板：发丝线 + 内高光 + 随高度变化的两层阴影、系统字体 tabular 大数字、Q3 chip、本季强调色的迷你柱状图；离镜头近时按高度给 ≤5px 景深虚化，落地清晰
圆环改白色细亮环（7→1.4px 越扩越细）+ 柔辉两层；尘点改带翻转与投影的浅色碎屑 + 12 条径向拉长的细火花；震屏偏竖向，砸落节拍与 18px 衰减不变
issuesEn: No duration was exported, so the workbench rendered md's 22f and cut off the hold after the slam
The debug title SCORE SLAM sat on the blurred dashboard and was half clipped; the blurred background still competed for attention instead of focusing on the card

The KPI card had a 3px grey border, heavy Helvetica and widely tracked label, like a wireframe; at 2.5× near the lens it was as sharp as when landed, so it never read as slamming down from in front of the camera
The shockwave was a 6px solid black circle and the dust was black squares, reading as stickers rather than impact
changesEn: Exported SCORE_SLAM_DURATION = 135 (from the source timeline: 30f of action and aftermath plus a 105f still hold)
Removed the debug title; dashboard blur raised to 9px with a radial scrim darkening in during the drop to pull focus onto the KPI card

The card is now a publication-grade KPI panel: hairline, inner highlight, a two-layer shadow that changes with height, system-font tabular figures, a Q3 chip and a mini bar chart with this quarter in the accent; depth-of-field blur up to 5px while near the lens, sharp on landing

The ring is now a thin white ring (thinning 7→1.4px as it grows) with a soft glow; dust became light debris that flips and casts shadows plus 12 radially stretched sparks; shake is biased vertically, with slam timing and the 18px decay unchanged
